en.question: When there are multiple <<6969>> or "Six Samurai" monsters in the Monster Zone, if all monsters on the field would be destroyed due to the effect of a card such as <<5114>>, can the『If this card would be destroyed, you can destroy a face-up "Six Samurai" monster you control instead』effect of <<6969>> be applied?
